description: This file defines a C# class 'StatelessWorkerGrain' implementing an Orleans grain with stateless worker attributes. It includes methods for activation, performing long calls with timers, retrieving call statistics, and a dummy method. The class manages activation IDs and logs various events.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerGrain
classes.description: An Orleans stateless worker grain class that manages activation IDs, performs timed calls, and logs activity.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerGrain
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger using the provided logger factory.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the activation method to assign a new GUID and log activation.

methods.name: LongCall
methods.description: Performs a long-running call, registers a timer, and logs the duration and call count.

methods.name: TimerCallback
methods.description: Static callback method for the grain timer that sets the task result to true.

methods.name: GetCallStats
methods.description: Returns statistics about calls and activation ID, including a simulated delay.

methods.name: DummyCall
methods.description: A dummy method that completes immediately.
